priority_ranked_issues.scope: EM-False, recurring across homophone and non-homophone rows
priority_ranked_issues.fix: Pre-tokenise compounds in the target side; consider a constrained decoder or post-hoc join rule for known compound lists.

priority_ranked_issues.issue: Proper-noun / rare-word OOV substitutions (WALDORF -> WALLDORF, SAXIFRAGE -> SAXOPHONE FRAGMENT)
priority_ranked_issues.scope: EM-False slice; vocabulary coverage gap rather than acoustic failure

priority_ranked_issues.scope: Phoneme level; 14 of 38 EM-False subs = 'Vowel' label (36.84%)
priority_ranked_issues.fix: Feature-aware rescoring does NOT help (vowels share place & manner; only length distinguishes). Retrain with vowel-length augmentation or use a duration-aware acoustic model.

priority_ranked_issues.issue: Casing artefacts inflate CER but have no research signal
priority_ranked_issues.fix: Lowercase all hypotheses before CER computation, or upper-case all references — pick a single convention. Already mitigated by CER-vs-WER comparison.

priority_ranked_issues.issue: Suffix hallucination and space-insertion (SHIPPING for SHIP, ROPE S for ROPES)
priority_ranked_issues.fix: Constrained decoding that penalises intra-word space insertion; subword-tokeniser fix if the issue persists at BPE level.

priority_ranked_issues.scope: Mostly correct; the failure is that reference uses one form and hypothesis uses the other
priority_ranked_issues.fix: Upstream: pick canonical form at training time. Downstream: no fix without breaking other usage; BERTScore already shows these are semantically equivalent.

priority_ranked_issues.issue: BERTScore F1 is high even on EM-False: 52.6% above 0.90
priority_ranked_issues.fix: Reporting: WER/CER overstates the practical error magnitude for lip-reading. Use BERTScore or human-rated utility alongside WER.
